FILS

Multimedia artist, creative technologist and storyteller. I enjoy experimenting, exploring and examining humanity through the lens of digitality, art, and culture.

Keyano

2026Current project. A hybrid keyboard-guitar and its software, Keyform.

Keyano is a computer keyboard-guitar that plays words as chords. Each of its 26 typing keys plays a note, and Keyform, my software, maps over 750 words to chords by how they sound, so “sea” and “see” can land on the same chord.

The Downward Spiral

2023Immersive narrative VR experience with motion capture

An immersive VR narrative about movement, performance and psychological tension. Viewers enter a dark, looping world that mirrors falling deeper into their own thoughts: a descent through identity breakdown and the thin line between control and chaos. Built in Unreal Engine with motion-capture performance, so characters move with lifelike weight.

Watch the experience Watch the interview

Peculiar Pop

2023Interactive musical VR experience

An immersive VR experience about the blurring line between technology, desire and overstimulation. The world responds to your presence: as you move, the soundscape shifts, rhythms swell, glitch and warp, and the architecture bends around you. Music works as both guide and mirror, turning interaction into a feedback loop that is strange, beautiful and hard to ignore. Built in Unreal Engine with reactive sound design.

Watch the demo Watch the interview

Why Try?

A live alter-ego performance that mixes DJing, storytelling and movement, played with an early prototype of Keyano. Special thanks to Ali Santana.
